journeyObjective: Enable self-paced tracking of the First Home Savings Knowledge goal and access mastery-oriented educational modules.
entryPoint: Rewards Overview dashboard loaded with customer balance and active learning progress.
completionDefinition: Customer reviews goal progress and opens a self-paced educational module or quiz.

miniJourneys.customerQuestion: Where do my points and savings knowledge stand today?
What educational steps and milestones can I explore next at my own pace?
miniJourneys.entryCondition: User has reviewed current balances and goal status

supportingSurfaces.purpose: Provide supplementary context on how points translate to financial literacy value without pressure.
